structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a busy modern office building in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant stack of colourful folders and a paperclip on its roof.
character: young admin intern (a white woman in her early 20s, red hair in a ponytail, green cardigan, lanyard)
scenes: she arrives with a coffee and sorts the post at the front desk while her inbox opens on a laptop.

she sets up a meeting room with chairs, a water jug and a screen showing abstract slides.
she updates a spreadsheet of abstract coloured rows and files documents into a cabinet.
she restocks a stationery cupboard and ticks off a checklist on a clipboard; dusk through the window.
props: a giant paperclip, a stapler, envelopes, a desk calendar, folders, a telephone, sticky notes
